timing_protocol.estimator: For job j: x_j=(log(T_consumer,j,0/T_fullIO,j,0)+log(T_consumer,j,1/T_fullIO,j,1))/2. T is sum of six measured update seconds excluding the two warmups; all normal observer work and decision synchronization included.
